description: Commercial Vehicle Enforcement Facilities is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. A Commercial Vehicle Enforcement Facility (CVEF) commonly called a Weigh Station (WS) is a checkpoint typically located directly off the State highways where the California Highway Patrol (CHP) inspects the weight of trucks and commercial vehicles. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency, CalSTA, Caltrans, CAOpenData, Commercial Vehicle Enforcement Facilities, CVEF, Weigh Stations. The bounding box given is -124.1077,32.5546,-114.7414,41.2708. The hub shows 2025-02-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is This application is available to the public.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
